Job Description:
 Title: Java J2EE 
 Type : Contract (24 months)
 Location: Albany, NY
 NOTE: GC OR USC only
 


 Candidates should have at least 84 months experience, and at least one of the following should apply
 1. Hands-on experience developing highly available and scalable multitier applications using Java 1.5+ , using data structures, algorithms, object oriented software design, JEE design patterns, and Service Oriented Architecture.
 2. Hands-on experience developing Enterprise Java Beans (EJB) that utilize JMS, MQ 6.0+ and/or Hibernate/JPA.
 3. Hands-on experience developing JAX-WS web services
 4. Experience developing and implementing web applications using JSF
 


  If you are interested in finding out more about opportunities near you, , please email me at parveen askitc.com
